unresolved_licensing_issues.title: Nmap Public Source License (NPSL) Commercial Redistribution Analysis
unresolved_licensing_issues.context: nmap is listed in debian-live/config/package-lists/itsa.list.chroot for live ISO distribution. The core application (src/itsa_network_os/) does not invoke, link, or depend on nmap. However, bundling nmap on a commercial Live ISO alongside proprietary add-ons requires legal review to ensure it constitutes mere aggregation rather than a derivative product under NPSL terms.
unresolved_licensing_issues.recommendation: Submit for qualified intellectual property counsel review before compiling commercial installation ISOs.

unresolved_licensing_issues.title: Debian Non-Free Firmware Redistribution Verification
unresolved_licensing_issues.context: Debian 13 Live ISO configurations include non-free-firmware for physical hardware Wi-Fi/NIC driver support. Certain vendor firmware blobs grant redistribution only under strict binary-unmodified conditions.
unresolved_licensing_issues.recommendation: Verify explicit redistribution grants for all included firmware packages during ISO build verification (TASK-017).
